scope: LibreCAD_3 adapter loss reporting for unrepresentable layer lineweights
finding: Layer::lineWidth stores arbitrary double values, but DXF layer lineweights use a discrete set. Before this change an unrepresentable width was replaced with widthDefault and exportFile reported no loss; bool save returned success.
change: Retain the existing widthDefault fallback, but emit one deduplicated loss note for nonrepresentable layer widths. File::save then reports false on lossy export while exportFile distinguishes write success from the loss.

verification.red: System codec focused regression for a 0.27 layer width failed before the fix because the loss-note count was zero.
verification.green: Focused tests pass 2/2 on macOS ARM64 with both the selected ABI-3 installed shared codec and the pinned d68fb1ed 2.0.0 static codec. Two distinct custom widths produce one note; R12, R14 and R2000 ASCII and binary outputs reopen with geometry; legacy loss is retained, bool save reports loss, and replacement by representable widths allows an R2000 retry without loss. Existing 0.25 modern round-trip and legacy loss controls pass.

limits: The follow-up is local and unmerged, and requires the earlier ordered LibreCAD_3 candidate patch and git apply --unidiff-zero. It does not resolve absent legacy width provenance, entity-width handling, save UI, other platforms, full application packaging, or any independent 3D semantic evidence. Scratch drawings were generated by the tests and were not committed.
native_ci_note: Hosted native run 43880983294 had successful Linux and Windows focused jobs, but macOS job 133346683154 was cancelled before any steps ran. The run is not a complete three-platform pass; the reason for cancellation was not established from job metadata.
